title: Most Preferred Plan
problem_intro: The RISE watchlist already does the hard parts: live prices on every row, holdings quantity and unrealised P&L on the row, swipe to trade, smooth tab switching and no crashes. But it does far more work than it shows, keeps memory it no longer needs and gives no sign when its prices are old. Measured on an OPPO CPH3009 (Android 17, 120 Hz) with a 20-stock list:
problem_points: Sitting idle on the list uses 185.5 % CPU (almost two cores) and redraws 39.6 times a second; 49.5 % of those frames are identical to the one before.
Scrolling delivers 75.3 fps on a 120 Hz screen (about 63 % of the frames offered) even though janky frames are only 0.34 %.
Opening and closing the watchlist ten times adds 60 MB that is not released; after five minutes the app holds 380.5 MB.
Offline, prices stay on screen but look live: no banner, no last-updated time (offline score 44.4). After a minute in the background, old prices show before live ones resume.
Release builds write the client code, cached responses and false 'API Failed' lines to the device log.
problem_outro: These come from a small number of causes in the code: live ticks rebuild whole rows and the header even when nothing visible changed, the header rebuilds on every scroll frame, rows are recreated on every list update and leave listeners behind, and the offline signals are either gated off or missing. The front-end changes below remove those causes; items that need BE or a Product decision are listed as left for later.

factors.title: Idle CPU and redraw
factors.problem: With no input, the watchlist keeps about two cores busy and redraws about 40 times a second, half of it drawing the same pixels.
factors.today: C1 185.5 % CPU; U4 39.6 fps; U5 49.5 % identical frames
factors.after: C1 ≤ 60 %; U4 ≈ 5–10 fps with A5, ≈ 15–20 fps without; U5 ≤ 10 % (estimates, re-measure in market hours)

causes.text: Every price packet rebuilds the whole row (name, badges, chips, SVGs, CAS row), including packets that change only fields the row does not show; the broadcaster re-publishes one mutated object per symbol.
The header wealth tile rebuilds twice per holdings tick and animates a page flip every 3 s for as long as the watchlist is open.
The indices rail creates new tick streams on every header build, multiplying header rebuild cost.
Packet parsing on the UI isolate and the texture compositing pass are not attributable from the code alone; profile before and after.

covers: All rebuilds and animations that do not change what is drawn
Header wealth tile rebuild rate and rotation (rotation interval needs Product)
not: The price feed's own update rate (BE question D1)
Analytics SDK background activity (I1, Product and BE)

factors.title: Scrolling and frame delivery
factors.problem: Frames are fast but a third of the display's 120 Hz frames are not delivered while scrolling.
factors.after: S5 ≥ 110 fps; ≈ 120 fps if the render-mode test confirms the cause; S1 unchanged or lower

causes.text: Each downward scroll update emits a new header state and rebuilds the landing header, wealth tile, indices rail, tab bar and banners every frame.
Android 11+ renders through a texture view, adding a copy and a second composition pass (verify with an A/B).
The whole screen rebuilds on each list update, the list shrink-wraps inside a bounded box, and visible rows are recomputed and resubscribed at every scroll end.

not: Display refresh-rate policy chosen by the OS

factors.title: Memory and leaks
factors.problem: Each visit to the watchlist leaves objects behind in the app-scoped cubit and shared streams.
factors.today: R9 +60.0 MB over 10 cycles; R3 380.5 MB; R2 361.2 MB (two states, ~352 / ~438 MB)
factors.after: R9 ≤ 20 MB; R3 ≤ 340 MB (estimates); R2 states explained by B7

causes.text: New GlobalKeys in build make every list update unmount and remount every row with its streams and controllers.
Rows never cancel their tooltip subscription or dispose their three controllers, and the listing replaces its StreamController on every build without closing it.
The cubit keeps the disposed screen's context, the indices rail adds an uncancelled listener per visit, and the subscribed-symbol list grows on every scroll.
Part of the growth may be Java-side (Java heap ~25 vs ~100 MB between runs, one WebView in process); needs a heap dump.

covers: Dart-side leaks in the module and its shared widgets
not: Java/SDK memory outside Flutter until B7 identifies it

factors.title: Offline and reconnect
factors.problem: Offline, the watchlist keeps its prices but says nothing, and they look live.
factors.today: O1 44.4: no banner, no last-updated marker, offline cold start stops at mPIN with a generic error
factors.after: O1 ≈ 77.8 with E1 + E2 (OF2, OF4, OF8 to Yes)

causes.text: The only offline message is gated on a bottom-bar index the RISE shell does not appear to set, and the connectivity listener stops after the first background.
Rows use the same style for live and stale prices; no time of last update.

covers: In-screen offline banner and stale marker behind flags (copy needs Product)
Connectivity listener that keeps working after background
not: Offline cold start past mPIN (E4, Product and security)

factors.title: Live prices and returning to the app
factors.problem: After a minute away, old prices show as if live until the socket reconnects; price changes arrive on whole seconds.
factors.today: U3: first tick 1.0 s after the screen reappears, stale prices first; U1 17.0 changes/min
factors.after: U3 ≈ 0.5 s to first tick with a longer socket delay; stale period marked by E2; U1 unchanged without a feed change

causes.text: The price socket is closed 15 s after the app is paused, so any return after that needs a reconnect and login before the first tick.
Nothing marks the reconnect period as not live.

covers: Configurable socket delay (needs a Product and BE agreement on background data)

factors.title: Opening the watchlist
factors.problem: Opening times are not measured yet, but the code adds avoidable waits on every visit.
factors.after: shorter by one MTF round-trip, ≥ 300 ms less with a saved sort, no shimmer on return (to be measured)

causes.text: A shimmer replaces the list on every visit although the app-scoped cubit still holds it.
The MTF list is awaited before the watchlist call starts; fixed 300 ms waits follow sorted loads.

covers: Serial waits and loading states inside the module

factors.title: Release logging and privacy
factors.problem: Release builds write user data and misleading lines to the device log and stringify whole responses to do it.
factors.today: client code and CleverTap attributes, doubled API URL and 'API Failed' on a 200 response in release logcat
factors.after: none of these in release builds

causes.text: CleverTap events are printed with print; cached responses are printed in full; the committed HEAD prints the bearer token.
An 'API Failed' line is written before every response, the URL log doubles the origin, and every response is stringified to log its size.
Firebase Performance logcat output is on in release; visibility callbacks print; the broadcaster logs the user id and symbol sets.

covers: All logging paths seen in the creation notes
not: The orientation events in logcat (not found in app code)

factors.title: Watchlist features
factors.problem: Depth, alerts and an order ticket need a full quote page, and rows have no mini chart.

causes.text: No quick-action sheet over the list.
No intraday series on rows.

not: The gesture and contents (Product) and the intraday series API (BE)

factors.title: Creation flow, accessibility and SDK widgets
factors.problem: Small frictions found while creating the list, plus Plotline widgets mounted on every open.
factors.today: prefilled name must be cleared; no add confirmation; two unlabeled icons; header shift; X3 9 third-party domains
factors.after: typing replaces the default name; add confirmed; icons labeled; header height constant; Plotline widgets only when a campaign exists (if the check confirms per-open requests)

causes.text: Name field not selected on focus; no success message on add.
No Semantics on the list menu and the search add icon.
Header height changes with the wealth tile state; Plotline widgets on every open.

covers: Creation-flow and accessibility fixes in the module and search
not: Which SDKs may use the network on the watchlist (I1, Product and BE)

phases.title: Phase 1 · Quick wins
phases.desc: Flag holder, the per-frame header fix, row cleanup, stream reuse and the release-logging clean-up. No visible change.

phases.title: Phase 2 · Structural
phases.desc: Stable keys and the tests that guard them; rows and the wealth tile rebuild only when their text changes; fewer rebuilds and waits on open.

phases.title: Phase 3 · Rendering
phases.desc: Wealth tile rotation on the watchlist (after Product), constant header height, and the render-mode A/B behind a flag.

phases.title: Phase 4 · Memory
phases.desc: Memory diff and CPU profile after phases 1–3 to find what remains outside Dart.

phases.title: Phase 5 · Offline and live data
phases.desc: Connectivity listener fix, offline banner, stale marker, longer socket delay and no shimmer on return, each behind its flag.

phases.title: Phase 6 · Features and creation flow
phases.desc: Quick-action sheet and sparkline after Product and BE, creation-flow polish, Plotline check and the broadcaster log request.
